1320 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and 400? 1320 mod 400 = 320, but leap year rule for years before 1582 is Julian calendar; Gregorian rule not applicable; but we use Gregorian arithmetic per instructions, so treat as proleptic Gregorian: 1320 divisible by 4 → leap year).  
57 days before 1320-01-11:  
Back 11 days → 1320-01-00 invalid, so back to 1320-01-00 = 1319-12-31.  
Remaining 57 - 11 = 46 days.  
Back 31 days of Dec → 1319-11-30. Remaining 46 - 31 = 15 days.  
Back 15 days in Nov → 1319-11-15.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1319-11-15
